title: APPROVAL OF A FIRST AMENDMENT AND ORDER RESETTING COMPENSATION UNDER PERMIT NO. 900 WITH WWL VEHICLE SERVICES AMERICAS, INC.
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF A FIRST AMENDMENT AND ORDER RESETTING COMPENSATION UNDER PERMIT NO. 900 WITH WWL VEHICLE SERVICES AMERICAS, INC.
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Transmittal 3
Summary
: Staff requests approval of a First Amendment and Order resetting compensation under Permit No. 900 with WWL Vehicle Services Americas, Inc. (WWL) concerning premises located at Berths 195-200A, for the purpose of operating a vehicle import/export processing terminal. The proposed First Amendment and Order advances Harbor Department's Strategic Plan Objective 3: Improved Financial Performance of Port Assets, Initiative 3 - Ensure that Port properties are revenue efficient and reflect current land values and market-based compensation. Approval of the proposed First Amendment to Permit No. 900 will: i) extend the term for five years through December 31, 2031, with an additional five-year extension option through 2036, exercisable by WWL; and ii) suspend Consumer Price Index (CPI)/General Rate Increase (GRI) adjustments for the year 2026. Approval of the proposed Order will set the Minimum Annual Guarantee (MAG) at $20,846,592 (i.e. $228,782 per acre) effective January 1, 2027, subject to increase annually thereafter by CPI.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is categorically exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article III Classes 1(14) and 1(18)(d) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve a First Amendment with WWL Vehicle Services Americas, Inc.; 3) approve the Order resetting compensation under Permit No. 900 with WWL Vehicle Services Americas, Inc.; 4) direct the Board Secretary to transmit the First Amendment and Order resetting compensation to the City Council for approval pursuant to Section 606 of the City Charter; 5) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the First Amendment and Order resetting compensation; and 6) adopt Resolution No. ___________and Order No.____________.
Planning & Strategy
summary: Approval of first amendment to Permit No. 900 with WWL Vehicle Services extending vehicle import/export terminal operations at Berths 195-200A through December 2031 with minimum annual guarantee of $20,846,592.
